review.end_note: The END route supplies the meeting-pattern model, the isolation-to-block equivalence, the exact block capacity, an attaining construction, and the periodic output rule. The stated t<=17 bound is correct for n<=10000, so the proposed enumeration and output fit the limits.
review.key_note: N6 determines both the infinity case and the complete optimal schedule for every feasible input; it is the appropriate construction key.
review.hazards_note: The hazards cover endpoint gaps, schedule dimensions and alphabet, the infinity output convention, and safe capacity arithmetic. The overflow check appropriately allows early stopping rather than mandating 64-bit arithmetic.
review.editorial_note: The editorial and reference solution use the same upper-middle-layer construction and periodic extension. Their ceil(t/2) support size equals floor((t-1)/2)+1. N4 states the intersecting-antichain bound precisely, including the parity where ordinary Sperner alone is insufficient.
